extensions.description: This agent's interface is MCP over stdio, not A2A. The card is a capability manifest and discovery record, not an A2A endpoint declaration; no A2A endpoint exists for this agent. The params carry the invocation facts a client config generator needs to wire this server from the card alone.

description: MCP server for the phlow agent runtime: bounded planner-coder-reviewer agent workflows under one shared safe runtime for CLI, TUI, and MCP, with operator-approved checks and a joint-attention coordination board for concurrent agents. This card is a discovery record and capability manifest for catalogues, registries, and client-config generators; the MCP server does not expose an A2A endpoint.
name: Phlow MCP Server

skills.description: Run bounded planner-coder-reviewer workflows against the shared runtime and read their state (flow_run, flow_status).
skills.name: Agent workflows

skills.description: Run the operator-approved checks configured for a workflow and read their verdicts (flow_check).
skills.name: Operator checks

skills.description: Publish, focus, align, and decide on the joint-attention coordination board shared by concurrent agents (flow_attention_publish, flow_attention_focus, flow_attention_alignment, flow_attention_decide).
skills.name: Joint attention
